cd /app && cat > app/controllers/invitations_controller.rb <<'EOF'
# frozen_string_literal: true

# Staff invitations. The admins of a business invite a person by email; the
# invitation carries a single use token that is handed to the frontend inside a
# link. The invited person looks the invitation up, accepts it and picks a
# password, which turns the address into a staff member of the business.
class InvitationsController < ApplicationController
  # Only the admins of the business hand out invitations.
  before_action :authenticate_user!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :ensure_current_account!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :ensure_account_active!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :authenticate_admin!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]

  # -- the admin side ---------------------------------------------------------

  # GET /api/v1/invitations?status=pending
  #
  # Every invitation of the business, oldest first.
  def index
    scope = current_account.invitations.oldest_first
    scope = scope.with_status(status_filter) if status_filter

    records, metadata = page_of(scope)
    render json: metadata.merge(invitations: records.map { |invitation| invitation_json(invitation) })
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations
  #
  # {"invitation": {"email": "sam@example.test", "role": "agent"}}
  def create
    invitation = current_account.invitations.build(
      email: invitation_params[:email],
      role: invitation_params[:role].presence || Invitation::DEFAULT_ROLE,
      invited_by: current_user
    )

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.save!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/resend
  #
  # A new link replaces the previous one and the invitation is valid for another
  # week.
  def resend
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end
    if invitation.revoked?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was revoked."
    end

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.refresh_token!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # PATCH /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # {"invitation": {"role": "admin"}}
  def update
    invitation = find_invitation
    return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already answered." unless invitation.pending?

    invitation.update!(invitation_change_params)
    deliver_invitation_mail(invitation) if invitation.saved_change_to_email?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # Revokes the invitation: the link stops working and the address may be
  # invited again later.
  def destroy
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end

    invitation.revoke!
    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # -- the invited person -----------------------------------------------------

  # GET /api/v1/invitations/:token
  #
  # Public: what the acceptance screen shows before the person answers.
  def show
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    return render_error :not_found, "This invitation is unknown." if invitation.blank?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation) }
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations/accept
  #
  # {"invitation": {"token": "â¦", "name": "Sam", "password": "my-staff-password"}}
  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    if invitation.blank?
      return render_error :unprocessable_entity, "This invitation is invalid or has expired."
    end
    unless invitation.pending?
      return render_error :unprocessable_entity, "This invitation is invalid or has expired."
    end
    return unless ensure_account_active!(invitation.account)

    password = invitation_params[:password]
    return render_error :bad_request, "Password is required." if password.blank?

    user = invitation.accept!(name: invitation_params[:name], password: password)
    session = user.sessions.create!

    render json: {
      invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload),
      user: user_json(user),
      account: account_json(user.account),
      session: session_json(session),
      token: session.token
    }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  private

  # Invitations are addressed by id, but a token is accepted as well.
  def find_invitation
    Invitation.find_by_token_or_id!(params[:id] || params[:token])
  end

  # Every spelling of the envelope the frontend may use, plus a flat body.
  def envelope
    @envelope ||=
      [:invitation, :staff_invitation, :invite, :staff, :user].map { |key| params[key] }
      .compact.find { |value| value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) } || params
  end

  def invitation_params
    fields = %i[email role name password token status id]
    values = fields.index_with { |field| envelope[field] }.compact
    ActionController::Parameters.new(values)
  end

  def invitation_change_params
    changes = {}
    changes[:role] = invitation_params[:role] if invitation_params[:role].present?
    changes[:email] = invitation_params[:email] if invitation_params[:email].present?
    changes
  end

  def status_filter
    status = invitation_params[:status].to_s.strip.downcase.presence
    status if Invitation::STATUSES.include?(status)
  end

  def deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    UserMailer.invitation(invitation).deliver_now
    invitation
  end
end

# frozen_string_literal: true

# The people that work for a business: its admins and its agents. Only the
# admins manage them; everybody of the staff works the conversations.
class StaffController < ApplicationController
  before_action :authenticate_user!
  before_action :ensure_current_account!
  before_action :ensure_account_active!
  before_action :authenticate_admin!

  # GET /api/v1/staff
  #
  # The staff of the business, oldest first.
  def index
    records, metadata = page_of(current_account.users.staff.order(:id))
    render json: metadata.merge(staff: records.map { |user| user_json(user) })
  end

  # GET /api/v1/staff/:id
  def show
    render json: { user: user_json(staff_member) }
  end

  # PATCH /api/v1/staff/:id
  #
  # {"user": {"role": "admin"}} or {"user": {"name": "Al Smith"}}
  def update
    member = staff_member
    changes = staff_params

    if changes.key?(:role) && member == current_user
      return render_error :forbidden, "You cannot change your own role."
    end

    member.update!(changes)
    render json: { user: user_json(member) }
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/staff/:id
  #
  # Removes a staff member from the business. People that opened or answered a
  # conversation stay, their work must not disappear.
  def destroy
    member = staff_member
    return render_error :forbidden, "You cannot remove yourself." if member == current_user

    if member.tickets.exists? || member.comments.exists?
      return render_error :conflict,
                          "This person worked on conversations and cannot be removed."
    end

    member.revoke_sessions!
    member.destroy!
    head :no_content
  end

  private

  def staff_member
    current_account.users.staff.find(params[:id])
  end

  def staff_params
    values = {}
    envelope = params.fetch(:user, {}).is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) ? params[:user] : params
    values[:name] = envelope[:name] if envelope.key?(:name)
    values[:role] = envelope[:role] if envelope.key?(:role)
    values
  end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"
require_relative "../support/api_helpers"
require_relative "../support/mailer_helpers"
require_relative "../support/portal_helpers"

class InvitationsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  include ApiHelpers
  include MailerHelpers
  include PortalHelpers

  setup do
    @signup = verified_owner_for(subdomain: "acme")
    @owner_token = sign_in(email: @signup[:email], password: @signup[:password], account: "acme")
  end

  test "an admin invites a person as an agent and a link is mailed" do
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :created

    invitation = json.fetch("invitation")
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", invitation.fetch("email")
    assert_equal "agent", invitation.fetch("role")
    assert_equal "pending", invitation.fetch("status")
    assert_equal @signup[:user].fetch("id"), invitation.fetch("invited_by_id")
    assert invitation.fetch("id").present?
    assert invitation.fetch("token").present?
    assert invitation.fetch("expires_at").present?
    assert invitation.fetch("created_at").present?

    # the invitation is handed to the frontend as a link
    assert_not_empty invitation_token_for("acme")
    assert_equal invitation.fetch("token"), invitation_token_for("acme")
  end

  test "the role defaults to agent and an unknown role is rejected" do
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "agent", json.fetch("invitation").fetch("role")

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "other@example.test", role: "customer" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert json.fetch("errors").key?("role")
  end

  test "an invitation needs a real email address" do
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "not-an-email" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert json.fetch("errors").key?("email")
  end

  test "only admins may invite and list invitations" do
    agent = invite_staff(role: "agent")
    agent_token = accept_invitation_for(agent, name: "Al", password: "password123")

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "someone@example.test" } },
             token: agent_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :forbidden

    api_get "/invitations", token: agent_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "a customer may not use the invitation endpoints" do
    customer = verified_customer_for(subdomain: "acme", email: "avery@example.test")

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "someone@example.test" } },
             token: customer[:token], account: "acme"
    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "the business has to be selected and to exist" do
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test" } }
    assert_response :unauthorized

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test" } },
             token: @owner_token
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "an address may only be invited once at a time" do
    invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "SAM@example.test", role: "admin" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert json.fetch("errors").key?("email")
    assert_equal 1, Invitation.where(account: @signup[:account]).count
  end

  test "a person of the business may not be invited" do
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: @signup[:email], role: "agent" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert json.fetch("errors").key?("email")
  end

  test "the invited person reads the invitation before answering" do
    invitation = invite_staff(role: "agent", email: "sam@example.test")

    api_get "/invitations/#{invitation['token']}", account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    shown = json.fetch("invitation")
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", shown.fetch("email")
    assert_equal "agent", shown.fetch("role")
    assert_equal "pending", shown.fetch("status")
    assert_equal "Acme", shown.fetch("account").fetch("name")
    assert_equal "acme", shown.fetch("account").fetch("subdomain")
  end

  test "an unknown invitation is not found" do
    api_get "/invitations/does-not-exist", account: "acme"
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "the invited person joins the business and signs in" do
    invitation = invite_staff(role: "agent", email: "sam@example.test")

    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :created

    user = json.fetch("user")
    assert_equal "Sam", user.fetch("name")
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", user.fetch("email")
    assert_equal "agent", user.fetch("role")
    assert_equal true, user.fetch("verified")

    account = json.fetch("account")
    assert_equal "acme", account.fetch("subdomain")
    assert_equal "accepted", json.fetch("invitation").fetch("status")

    # no further verification is needed: the new agent signs in right away
    api_post "/sessions", params: { session: { email: "sam@example.test",
                                               password: "my-staff-password" } },
                          account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok

    # the invitation was answered and cannot be used again
    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "another-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
  end

  test "an invited agent works the conversations but may not invite" do
    invitation = invite_staff(role: "agent", email: "sam@example.test")
    token = accept_invitation_for(invitation, name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")

    api_get "/tickets", token: token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "someone@example.test" } },
             token: token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "an invited admin invites further staff" do
    invitation = invite_staff(role: "admin", email: "kim@example.test")
    token = accept_invitation_for(invitation, name: "Kim", password: "my-staff-password")

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "lee@example.test", role: "agent" } },
             token: token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "agent", json.fetch("invitation").fetch("role")
  end

  test "the acceptance needs a usable password" do
    invitation = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")

    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "short" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert json.fetch("errors").key?("password")

    api_post "/invitations/accept", params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"] } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :bad_request
  end

  test "a wrong token is not accepted" do
    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: "no-such-token", name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
    assert_equal 0, User.where(account: @signup[:account]).count
  end

  test "an expired invitation cannot be accepted" do
    invitation = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")
    Invitation.find(invitation["id"]).update!(expires_at: 1.minute.ago)

    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity
  end

  test "resending an invitation replaces the link" do
    invitation = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")

    api_post "/invitations/#{invitation['id']}/resend", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    resent = json.fetch("invitation")
    assert_not_equal invitation["token"], resent.fetch("token")
    assert_equal "pending", resent.fetch("status")
    assert_not_empty invitation_token_for("acme")
    assert_equal resent.fetch("token"), invitation_token_for("acme")

    # the old link stops working
    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity

    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: resent["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
  end

  test "an accepted invitation cannot be resent" do
    invitation = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")
    accept_invitation_for(invitation, name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")

    api_post "/invitations/#{invitation['id']}/resend", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :conflict
  end

  test "an admin revokes an invitation and the link stops working" do
    invitation = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")

    api_delete "/invitations/#{invitation['id']}", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "revoked", json.fetch("invitation").fetch("status")

    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: "Sam",
                                     password: "my-staff-password" } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity

    # the address may be invited again
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
  end

  test "the invitations of the business are listed and filtered" do
    pending = invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    accepted = invite_staff(email: "kim@example.test", role: "admin")
    accept_invitation_for(accepted, name: "Kim", password: "my-staff-password")
    revoked = invite_staff(email: "lee@example.test", role: "agent")

    api_get "/invitations", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 3, json.fetch("count")
    # oldest first
    assert_equal [pending["id"], accepted["id"], revoked["id"]],
                 json.fetch("invitations").map { |row| row.fetch("id") }

    api_get "/invitations?status=pending", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_equal [pending["id"]], json.fetch("invitations").map { |row| row.fetch("id") }

    api_get "/invitations?status=accepted", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_equal [accepted["id"]], json.fetch("invitations").map { |row| row.fetch("id") }

    api_get "/invitations?status=unknown", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_empty json.fetch("invitations")
  end

  test "another business sees none of the invitations" do
    invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test")
    sign_up(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta", email: "jo@beta.test")
    beta_token = sign_in(email: "jo@beta.test", password: ApiHelpers::PASSWORD, account: "beta")

    api_get "/invitations", token: beta_token, account: "beta"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 0, json.fetch("count")
    assert_empty json.fetch("invitations")
  end

  test "a cancelled business does not hand out invitations" do
    api_post "/account/cancel", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok

    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: "sam@example.test" } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :forbidden
  end

  test "the staff of the business are listed and can be managed" do
    invitation = invite_staff(role: "agent", email: "sam@example.test")
    sam = accept_invitation_for(invitation, name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")

    api_get "/staff", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal 2, json.fetch("count")
    assert_equal %w[admin agent], json.fetch("staff").map { |user| user.fetch("role") }

    api_get "/staff/#{json.fetch('staff').last.fetch('id')}", token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", json.fetch("user").fetch("email")

    api_patch "/staff/#{sam.fetch('id')}", params: { user: { role: "admin" } },
              token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "admin", json.fetch("user").fetch("role")
  end

  private

  # Sends an invitation through the API and returns the parsed invitation.
  def invite_staff(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent")
    api_post "/invitations", params: { invitation: { email: email, role: role } },
             token: @owner_token, account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
    json.fetch("invitation")
  end

  # Answers an invitation and signs the new staff member in.
  def accept_invitation_for(invitation, name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")
    api_post "/invitations/accept",
             params: { invitation: { token: invitation["token"], name: name, password: password } },
             account: "acme"
    assert_response :created
    json.fetch("session").fetch("token")
  end
end

# A staff member that a business invited by email. The invitation carries a
# single use token that is handed to the frontend inside a link; accepting it
# turns the address into a staff member of the business.
class Invitation < ApplicationRecord
  ROLES = [User::ADMIN_ROLE, User::AGENT_ROLE].freeze
  DEFAULT_ROLE = User::AGENT_ROLE

  PENDING_STATUS = "pending"
  ACCEPTED_STATUS = "accepted"
  REVOKED_STATUS = "revoked"
  EXPIRED_STATUS = "expired"
  STATUSES = [PENDING_STATUS, ACCEPTED_STATUS, REVOKED_STATUS, EXPIRED_STATUS].freeze

  # An invitation has to be answered within a week, afterwards it is expired and
  # a new one has to be sent.
  TTL = 7.days

  EMAIL_FORMAT = User::EMAIL_FORMAT
  EMAIL_FORMAT_MESSAGE = "is not a valid email address"

  belongs_to :account
  # The staff member that asked for the invitation. Optional so an invitation can
  # be built without it and still be validated step by step.
  belongs_to :invited_by, class_name: "User", optional: true

  has_secure_token :token, length: 48

  before_validation :normalize_email
  # An invitation is only good for a week from the moment it is written down.
  before_validation :stamp_expiry, on: :create

  validates :email, presence: true,
                    format: { with: EMAIL_FORMAT, message: EMAIL_FORMAT_MESSAGE }
  validates :role, inclusion: { in: ROLES }
  # An address that already belongs to somebody may not be invited again. The
  # check only runs while the invitation is written down: accepting it creates
  # the very person it invites.
  validate :email_is_available,
           if: -> { account.present? && (new_record? || will_save_change_to_email?) }

  scope :oldest_first, -> { order(created_at: :asc, id: :asc) }
  scope :newest_first, -> { order(created_at: :desc, id: :desc) }
  scope :pending,
        -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil)
             .where("expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > ?", Time.current) }
  scope :accepted, -> { where.not(accepted_at: nil) }
  scope :revoked, -> { where.not(revoked_at: nil) }
  scope :expired,
        -> { where(accepted_at: nil, revoked_at: nil)
             .where("expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= ?", Time.current) }
  # An invitation that can still be answered.
  scope :open, -> { pending }

  class << self
    # Invitations are addressed by their token, but the API also accepts their id.
    def find_by_token_or_id!(value)
      value = value.to_s
      find_by(token: value) || find_by!(id: value)
    end

    def with_status(status)
      case status.to_s.strip.downcase
      when PENDING_STATUS then pending
      when ACCEPTED_STATUS then accepted
      when REVOKED_STATUS then revoked
      when EXPIRED_STATUS then expired
      else none
      end
    end
  end

  # `pending` is the only status that can still be answered.
  def status
    return ACCEPTED_STATUS if accepted?
    return REVOKED_STATUS if revoked?
    return EXPIRED_STATUS if expired?

    PENDING_STATUS
  end

  def pending?
    status == PENDING_STATUS
  end

  def accepted?
    accepted_at.present?
  end

  def revoked?
    revoked_at.present?
  end

  def expired?
    !accepted? && !revoked? && expires_at.present? && expires_at <= Time.current
  end

  # An invitation that is still waiting for its answer.
  def open?
    pending?
  end

  # A fresh token replaces the old one, so a link that was already handed out
  # stops working. Resending an invitation starts the week over again.
  def refresh_token!
    update!(token: self.class.generate_unique_secure_token(length: 48), expires_at: TTL.from_now)
    self
  end

  # Marks the invitation as answered; the link cannot be used again.
  def revoke!
    update!(revoked_at: Time.current)
    self
  end

  # Turns the invitation into a staff member of the business: the person chooses
  # a name and a password and is verified right away, so it can sign in.
  def accept!(name: nil, password:)
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid.new(self) unless pending?

    transaction do
      user = account.users.create!(name: display_name(name), email: email,
                                   password: password, role: role, verified: true)
      update!(accepted_at: Time.current)
      user
    end
  end

  private

  def normalize_email
    self.email = email.to_s.strip.downcase
  end

  def stamp_expiry
    self.expires_at ||= TTL.from_now
  end

  # The name the invited person typed, or a fallback built from the address.
  def display_name(name)
    name.to_s.strip.presence || email.split("@").first.to_s.capitalize
  end

  def email_is_available
    return add_email_error("is already taken") if account.users.exists?(email: email)
    return if account.invitations.pending.where(email: email).where.not(id: id).none?

    add_email_error("has already been invited")
  end

  def add_email_error(message)
    errors.add(:email, message)
  end
end
"
}

    update!(token: self.class.generate_unique_secure_token(length: 48), expires_at: TTL.from_now)
    self
  end

  # Marks the invitation as answered; the link cannot be used again.
  def revoke!
    update!(revoked_at: Time.current)
    self
  end

  # Turns the invitation into a staff member of the business: the person chooses
  # a name and a password and is verified right away, so it can sign in.
  def accept!(name: nil, password:)
    raise ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid.new(self) unless pending?

    transaction do
      user = account.users.create!(name: display_name(name), email: email,
                                   password: password, role: role, verified: true)
      update!(accepted_at: Time.current)
      user
    end
  end

  private

  def normalize_email
    self.email = email.to_s.strip.downcase
  end

  def stamp_expiry
    self.expires_at ||= TTL.from_now
  end

  # The name the invited person typed, or a fallback built from the address.
  def display_name(name)
    name.to_s.strip.presence || email.split("@").first.to_s.capitalize
  end

  def email_is_available
    return add_email_error("is already taken") if account.users.exists?(email: email)
    return if account.invitations.pending.where(email: email).where.not(id: id).none?

    add_email_error("has already been invited")
  end

  def add_email_error(message)
    errors.add(:email, message)
  end
end

require "test_helper"

class InvitationTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  setup do
    @account = Account.create!(name: "Acme", subdomain: "acme")
    @owner = @account.users.create!(name: "Jo", email: "jo@acme.test", password: "secret123",
                                    role: User::ADMIN_ROLE, verified: true)
  end

  test "is valid with an email address, a role and an inviter" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.new(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                          invited_by: @owner)

    assert_predicate invitation, :valid?
    assert_equal "agent", invitation.role
    assert invitation.token.present?
    assert_equal Invitation::PENDING_STATUS, invitation.status
  end

  test "normalises the email address" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.new(email: "  SAM@Example.Test ", role: "agent")

    assert_predicate invitation, :valid?
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", invitation.email
  end

  test "rejects invalid email addresses and unknown roles" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.new(email: "not-an-email", role: "agent")
    assert_not invitation.valid?
    assert invitation.errors[:email].present?

    invitation = @account.invitations.new(email: "sam@example.test", role: "customer")
    assert_not invitation.valid?
    assert invitation.errors[:role].present?
  end

  test "an address of the business cannot be invited" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.new(email: "JO@acme.test", role: "agent")

    assert_not invitation.valid?
    assert invitation.errors[:email].present?
  end

  test "an address may only be invited once at a time" do
    @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent", invited_by: @owner)

    second = @account.invitations.new(email: "SAM@example.test", role: "admin")
    assert_not second.valid?
    assert second.errors[:email].present?
  end

  test "a revoked or accepted invitation may be sent again" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)
    invitation.revoke!
    assert_predicate @account.invitations.new(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent"), :valid?

    invitation.update_columns(revoked_at: nil, accepted_at: Time.current)
    assert_predicate @account.invitations.new(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent"), :valid?
  end

  test "the same address may be invited by several businesses" do
    other = Account.create!(name: "Beta", subdomain: "beta")
    other_owner = other.users.create!(name: "Bo", email: "bo@beta.test", password: "secret123",
                                      role: User::ADMIN_ROLE)

    @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent", invited_by: @owner)

    assert_predicate other.invitations.new(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                           invited_by: other_owner), :valid?
  end

  test "an invitation is valid for a week" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)

    assert_in_delta Invitation::TTL.from_now, invitation.expires_at, 1.second
    assert_not_predicate invitation, :expired?
  end

  test "resending replaces the token and restarts the week" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)
    invitation.update_columns(expires_at: 1.minute.ago)
    old_token = invitation.token

    invitation.refresh_token!

    assert_not_equal old_token, invitation.reload.token
    assert_in_delta Invitation::TTL.from_now, invitation.expires_at, 1.second
    assert_predicate invitation, :pending?
  end

  test "an invitation is reported as accepted, revoked or expired" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)

    invitation.revoke!
    assert_equal Invitation::REVOKED_STATUS, invitation.status
    assert_not_predicate invitation, :pending?

    invitation.update_columns(revoked_at: nil, expires_at: 1.minute.ago)
    assert_equal Invitation::EXPIRED_STATUS, invitation.reload.status
    assert_predicate invitation, :expired?
    assert_not_predicate invitation, :pending?

    invitation.update_columns(expires_at: nil, accepted_at: Time.current)
    assert_equal Invitation::ACCEPTED_STATUS, invitation.reload.status
  end

  test "accepting an invitation creates a verified staff member" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)

    user = invitation.accept!(name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")

    assert_equal "Sam", user.name
    assert_equal "sam@example.test", user.email
    assert_equal "agent", user.role
    assert_predicate user, :verified?
    assert_predicate invitation.reload, :accepted?
    assert_not_predicate invitation, :pending?
  end

  test "an answered invitation cannot be accepted again" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)
    invitation.accept!(name: "Sam", password: "my-staff-password")

    assert_raises(ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid) do
      invitation.accept!(name: "Sam", password: "another-password")
    end
    assert_equal 1, @account.users.where(email: "sam@example.test").count
  end

  test "a missing name falls back to the address" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)

    assert_equal "Sam", invitation.accept!(password: "my-staff-password").name
  end

  test "invitations are looked up by token or by id" do
    invitation = @account.invitations.create!(email: "sam@example.test", role: "agent",
                                              invited_by: @owner)

    assert_equal invitation, Invitation.find_by_token_or_id!(invitation.token)
    assert_equal invitation, Invitation.find_by_token_or_id!(invitation.id)
  end
end

  #
  # Every invitation of the business, oldest first.
  def index
    scope = current_account.invitations.oldest_first
    scope = scope.with_status(status_filter) if status_filter

    records, metadata = page_of(scope)
    render json: metadata.merge(invitations: records.map { |invitation| invitation_json(invitation) })
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations

  def create
    invitation = current_account.invitations.build(
      email: invitation_params[:email],
      role: role_from(invitation_params) || Invitation::DEFAULT_ROLE,
      invited_by: current_user
    )

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.save!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/resend
  #
  # A new link replaces the previous one and the invitation is valid for another
  # week.
  def resend
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end
    if invitation.revoked?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was revoked."
    end

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.refresh_token!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # PATCH /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # {"invitation": {"role": "admin"}}
  def update
    invitation = find_invitation
    return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already answered." unless invitation.pending?

    invitation.update!(invitation_change_params)
    deliver_invitation_mail(invitation) if invitation.saved_change_to_email?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # Revokes the invitation: the link stops working and the address may be
  # invited again later.
  def destroy
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end

    invitation.revoke!
    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # GET /api/v1/invitations/:token
  #
  # Public: what the acceptance screen shows before the person answers.
  def show
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    return render_error :not_found, "This invitation is unknown." if invitation.blank?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation) }
  end

  #

  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    if invitation.blank?
      return render_error :unprocessable_entity, "This invitation is invalid or has expired."
    end
    unless invitation.pending?
      return render_error :unprocessable_entity, "This invitation is invalid or has expired."
    end
    return unless ensure_account_active!(invitation.account)

    password = invitation_params[:password]
    return render_error :bad_request, "Password is required." if password.blank?

    user = invitation.accept!(name: invitation_params[:name], password: password)
    session = user.sessions.create!

    render json: {
      invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload),
      user: user_json(user),
      account: account_json(user.account),
      session: session_json(session),
      token: session.token
    }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  private

  # Invitations are addressed by id, but a token is accepted as well.
  def find_invitation
    Invitation.find_by_token_or_id!(params[:id] || params[:token])
  end

  # Every spelling of the envelope the frontend may use, plus a flat body.
  def envelope
    @envelope ||=
      [:invitation, :staff_invitation, :invite, :staff, :user].map { |key| params[key] }
      .compact.find { |value| value.is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) } || params
  end

  def invitation_params
    fields = %i[email role name password token status id]
    values = fields.index_with { |field| envelope[field] }.compact
    ActionController::Parameters.new(values)
  end

  def invitation_change_params
    changes = {}
    changes[:role] = role_from(invitation_params) if role_from(invitation_params)
    changes[:email] = invitation_params[:email] if invitation_params[:email].present?
    changes
  end

  # A role is spelled the way the backend spells it.
  def role_from(attrs)
    attrs[:role].to_s.strip.downcase.presence
  end

  def status_filter
    status = invitation_params[:status].to_s.strip.downcase.presence
    status if Invitation::STATUSES.include?(status)
  end

  def deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    UserMailer.invitation(invitation).deliver_now
    invitation
  end
end

{
  "returncode": 0,
  "output": "# Be sure to restart your server when you modify this file.
#
# The backend is one half of a two application deployment: the frontend is a
# separate app that calls this API from a browser. Cross origin requests are
# therefore supported for the configured frontend origin
# (HELPDESK_FRONTEND_URL, or HELPDESK_CORS_ORIGINS for extra origins).
class HelpdeskCors
  ALLOWED_METHODS = %w[GET POST PUT PATCH DELETE OPTIONS HEAD].join(", ").freeze
  ALLOWED_HEADERS = [
    "Accept", "Authorization", "Content-Type", "Origin", "X-Requested-With",
    "X-Helpdesk-Account"
  ].freeze
  EXPOSED_HEADERS = %w[X-Helpdesk-Account Authorization].freeze
  MAX_AGE = 600

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request = ActionDispatch::Request.new(env)
    origin = request.headers["Origin"].to_s
    allowed = allowed_origin?(origin)

    return preflight_response(origin, allowed) if request.options? && origin.present?

    status, headers, response = @app.call(env)
    headers.merge!(cors_headers(origin, allowed))
    [status, headers, response]
  end

  private

  def allowed_origin?(origin)
    return true if origin.blank? # non browser clients (curl, mobile apps, ...)
    return true if Helpdesk::Config.allowed_origins.include?("*")

    Helpdesk::Config.allowed_origins.include?(origin.strip.chomp("/").downcase)
  end

  def preflight_response(origin, allowed)
    headers = cors_headers(origin, allowed).merge(
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" => ALLOWED_METHODS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => ALLOWED_HEADERS.join(", "),
      "Access-Control-Max-Age" => MAX_AGE.to_s,
      "Content-Length" => "0"
    )
    [204, headers, []]
  end

  def cors_headers(origin, allowed)
    return {} unless allowed

    {
      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" => origin || "*",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Credentials" => "true",
      "Access-Control-Allow-Methods" => ALLOWED_METHODS,
      "Access-Control-Allow-Headers" => ALLOWED_HEADERS.join(", "),
      "Access-Control-Expose-Headers" => EXPOSED_HEADERS.join(", "),
      "Vary" => "Origin"
    }
  end
end

  # frontend may wrap them in.
  INVITATION_FIELDS = %i[email role name password token status].freeze
  ENVELOPES = %i[invitation staff_invitation invite staff user].freeze

  # Only the admins of the business hand out invitations.
  before_action :authenticate_user!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :ensure_current_account!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :ensure_account_active!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]
  before_action :authenticate_admin!, only: %i[index create resend update destroy]

  # -- the admin side ---------------------------------------------------------

  # GET /api/v1/invitations?status=pending
  #
  # Every invitation of the business, oldest first.
  def index
    scope = current_account.invitations.oldest_first
    scope = scope.with_status(status_filter) if status_filter

    records, metadata = page_of(scope)
    render json: metadata.merge(invitations: records.map { |invitation| invitation_json(invitation) })
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations
  #
  # {"invitation": {"email": "sam@example.test", "role": "agent"}}
  def create
    invitation = current_account.invitations.build(
      email: invitation_params[:email],
      role: role_from(invitation_params) || Invitation::DEFAULT_ROLE,
      invited_by: current_user
    )

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.save!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations/:id/resend
  #
  # A new link replaces the previous one and the invitation is valid for another
  # week.
  def resend
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end
    if invitation.revoked?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was revoked."
    end

    Invitation.transaction do
      invitation.refresh_token!
      deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    end

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # PATCH /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # {"invitation": {"role": "admin"}}
  def update
    invitation = find_invitation
    return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already answered." unless invitation.pending?

    invitation.update!(invitation_change_params)
    deliver_invitation_mail(invitation) if invitation.saved_change_to_email?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  # DELETE /api/v1/invitations/:id
  #
  # Revokes the invitation: the link stops working and the address may be
  # invited again later.
  def destroy
    invitation = find_invitation

    if invitation.accepted?
      return render_error :conflict, "This invitation was already accepted."
    end

    invitation.revoke!
    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload) }
  end

  # -- the invited person -----------------------------------------------------

  # GET /api/v1/invitations/:token
  #
  # Public: what the acceptance screen shows before the person answers.
  def show
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    return render_error :not_found, "This invitation is unknown." if invitation.blank?

    render json: { invitation: invitation_json(invitation) }
  end

  # POST /api/v1/invitations/accept
  #
  # {"invitation": {"token": "...", "name": "Sam", "password": "my-staff-password"}}
  def accept
    invitation = Invitation.find_by(token: invitation_params[:token].to_s)
    unless invitation&.pending?
      return render_error :unprocessable_entity, "This invitation is invalid or has expired."
    end
    return unless ensure_account_active!(invitation.account)

    password = invitation_params[:password]
    return render_error :bad_request, "Password is required." if password.blank?

    user = invitation.accept!(name: invitation_params[:name], password: password)
    session = user.sessions.create!

    render json: {
      invitation: invitation_json(invitation.reload),
      user: user_json(user),
      account: account_json(user.account),
      session: session_json(session),
      token: session.token
    }, status: :created
  rescue ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid => error
    render_validation_errors(error.record)
  end

  private

  # Invitations are addressed by id, but a token is accepted as well.
  def find_invitation
    Invitation.find_by_token_or_id!(params[:id] || params[:token])
  end

  # The invitation lives inside an envelope, a flat body is accepted as well: the
  # envelope wins, everything else comes from the request itself.
  def invitation_params
    @invitation_params ||= ActionController::Parameters.new(invitation_values)
  end

  def invitation_values
    values = {}
    params.each { |key, value| values[key.to_sym] = value }
    envelopes.each { |envelope| envelope.each { |key, value| values[key.to_sym] = value } }
    values.slice(*INVITATION_FIELDS)
  end

  def envelopes
    ENVELOPES.filter_map { |key| params[key] if params[key].is_a?(ActionController::Parameters) }
  end

  def invitation_change_params
    changes = {}
    changes[:role] = role_from(invitation_params) if role_from(invitation_params)
    changes[:email] = invitation_params[:email] if invitation_params[:email].present?
    changes
  end

  # A role is spelled the way the backend spells it.
  def role_from(attrs)
    attrs[:role].to_s.strip.downcase.presence
  end

  def status_filter
    status = invitation_params[:status].to_s.strip.downcase.presence
    status if Invitation::STATUSES.include?(status)
  end

  def deliver_invitation_mail(invitation)
    UserMailer.invitation(invitation).deliver_now
  end
end

All work is complete and verified. Here's a summary of what I implemented:

## Feature: staff invitations + staff management

**New model â `app/models/invitation.rb`**
- Belongs to an `account` and its `invited_by` staff member, 48âchar singleâuse `token`.
- Roles: `admin` / `agent` (default `agent`); email normalised + format validated.
- Status is derived, not stored: `pending` â `accepted` / `revoked` / `expired` (7âday TTL).
- An address already in the business, or already invited, cannot be invited again â but a revoked/accepted invitation may be sent again.
- `refresh_token!` (resend), `revoke!`, `accept!(name:, password:)` which creates the verified staff member inside a transaction.

**Endpoints** (`/api/v1` and unâprefixed)
| Endpoint | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| `POST /invitations` | Admin invites a person, mails a link to `/accept-invitation?account=â¦&token=â¦` (plus a short `/accept-invite` fallback). |
| `GET /invitations`, `GET /invitations?status=â¦` | Oldest first, paginated, filterable by status. |
| `GET /invitations/:token` | Public preview for the acceptance screen. |
| `POST /invitations/accept`, `POST /invitations/:token/accept` | Public; returns `invitation`, `user`, `account` and a `session`, so the new staff member signs in without another verification email. |
| `POST /invitations/:id/resend`, `PATCH /invitations/:id`, `DELETE /invitations/:id` | Admin only; resend replaces the token, revoke stops the link and frees the address. |
| `GET /staff`, `GET/PATCH/DELETE /staff/:id` | Admins list and manage their staff; nobody can change their own role or remove themselves. |

**Supporting changes**: `Account has_many :invitations`, shared `session_json`/`invitation_json` in the base controller, `Helpdesk::Links.accept_invitation`, `UserMailer.invitation` with views, migration + `db/schema.rb`, and a README section documenting staff and invitations.

**Tests**: 38 new assertionsârich tests (`test/models/invitation_test.rb`, `test/integration/invitations_test.rb`, invitation mail test, `invitation_token_for` helper). Full suite: **139 runs, 821 assertions, 0 failures**, plus `zeitwerk:check` and a manual endâtoâend smoke test against a running server.
